response.overview: # Translation  It tells the story of a worker named Shahrul who likes to prepare all his tasks at the last minute. Shahrul not only enjoys procrastinating with his office work, but he also frequently does the same in other aspects. Nevertheless, he still maintains a high level of commitment when carrying out his duties. The arrival of an intern student, Syakila, who is also a girl that Shahrul has had a crush on since his university days, has motivated Shahrul to come to work more enthusiastically. Syakila is also a beautiful girl from a wealthy family. One day, Kak Ziela, Shahrul's manager, gave him a task to prepare a work proposal document. As usual, Shahrul procrastinated in printing the work proposal that was already prepared. As a kind-hearted colleague, Aiman frequently reminded Shahrul about the proposal document. However, misfortune came unexpectedly. Suddenly the printer broke down. Afraid of being scolded by his manager, Shahrul rushed to find a nearby printing shop.
